subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup treat 300 seconds of streamed bytes without an increase in aggregate `completed` as a terminal stalled pull for all supported Ollama endpoints?
rationale: The implementation fixes the indefinite hang cleanly, but choosing `completed` as the authoritative semantic-progress signal intentionally changes upgrade behavior for status-only or unusual pull streams and cannot be settled by green CI alone.

options.title: Confirm semantic watchdog
options.body: Accept the 300-second completed-based fail-closed default because it matches the existing idle budget and avoids any fixed total lifetime for healthy pulls.

options.title: Require broader progress compatibility
options.body: Keep the PR open until the watchdog recognizes another contract-backed progress signal or live proof demonstrates that supported long-running Ollama pulls always advance `completed` within the budget.

recommendation.title: Confirm semantic watchdog
recommendation.body: Accept the 300-second completed-based fail-closed default because it matches the existing idle budget and avoids any fixed total lifetime for healthy pulls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same Ollama onboarding and model-pull path makes this the strongest available feature-history routing candidate.
